remarks: Rare opportunity to acquire a legal three-unit residential property situated on 1.18 acres within Wilton's R-1 zoning district. Currently configured as three separate residential units, the property offers income potential with flexibility. The generous parcel size and underlying zoning may present future redevelopment or expansion potential, subject to local zoning regulations and all required municipal approvals. Additional basement space and exterior storage enhance functionality and long-term value. Conveniently located with easy access to Route 7, shopping, dining, and major commuting routes. Buyers are responsible for performing all independent due diligence regarding zoning, permitted uses, redevelopment feasibility, and approvals prior to submitting an offer. Seller makes no representation whatsoever of the property or any of it's condition.
